#Poetry #Painting #SummersEnd

Last Day of Vacation

each day’s current is loss-driven
undertoes of grief swirl at my ankles
like soft kisses
it doesn’t have to be hard or painful
or scary, this languid letting go

- Vanessa Shields

🎨 Sue Greenwood
